decisions.decision: Control language: joined boxes choose one from a set (segmented control, five-cell axis) and are radios — picking is final, Clear in the caption line is the only way back, the caption line reserves Clear's height (24px desktop, 44px touch); a square and a word record an independent on/off (checkbox, defects, Show changes) with one focus rule — the small square fills pen blue, the ring goes around square and word; a lone hairline box or an underlined word is an action
decisions.rationale: Mark with two Impeccable critiques, 2026-09-14; sketch 008 README records every round

decisions.decision: 2px hover and 2px focus ring with fixed outer dimensions; joined seams handled by stacking (z-index), not margins; underlines keep 1.5px
decisions.rationale: 1.5px borders and rings render as 1px at DPR 1; half-pixel compensation shrank the box (Impeccable)

decisions.decision: Invalid = the sentence beneath, the value kept, no ring; the ring means focus only
High contrast: selection stays a fill in the system Highlight colour through forced-color-adjust: none; a picked box's focus ring takes CanvasText; checked in Chrome's forced-colors emulation by Mark
decisions.rationale: an outline stand-in collided with the focus ring

decisions.decision: Twelve settled values on the sheet: pen blue for every on state; 0.04em on every uppercase caption, field captions and axis names at 500, 600 for region names only; 6px beneath a region name; 128px date / 56px numeric field tokens (48px clipped −12.5 and 120.5); 0.8125rem control, option and defect text; hairline prose baseline, no thickening on focus; text-face italic anchors; fields grow to 1rem at ≤600px; 65ch status line; Show changes 32px/44px; joined tracks keep 186px/216px
decisions.rationale: Mark, 2026-09-14: small control text, comfortably sized targets, larger text for entering values

decisions.decision: Defects are 007's two captioned groups, Every recipe / This recipe only; the '· declared' suffix is retired everywhere
decisions.rationale: 007 ninth round; the sheet had lagged

decisions.decision: Clear moves focus programmatically only when activated by keyboard (event.detail === 0)
decisions.rationale: Chrome shows no :focus-visible on script focus after a mouse click; Mark's recording showed focus 'skipping' the first cell
